newsitem.title: HUNGARY: GLOBUS RAISES 1996 DIVIDEND TO 12 PCT.
newsitem.headline: GLOBUS RAISES 1996 DIVIDEND TO 12 PCT.

text.p: The annual meeting of the shareholders of canned food producer Globus decided on Friday that the company would pay 12 percent dividend on the 1996 earnings, instead of the originally planned eight percent, the Hungarian news agency MTI said.
MTI did not say what was the reason for the change in the company's plan.
Globus officials were not immediately available to comment.
Globus will pay out some 119 million forints as dividend, MTI said.
The pre-tax profit of the company was 169.35 million forint in 1996 on net sales of 5.38 billion forints, MTI added.

An unaudited earnings report published earlier said that Globus posted a pre-tax profit of 260.7 million forints in 1995, and the company's after-tax profit dropped to some 17o million forints in 1996 from 248 million in 1995.
